qmc_reference.title: Quantum Monte Carlo Study of the Disordered Attractive Hubbard Model
qmc_reference.authors: R. T. Scalettar, N. Trivedi, and C. Huscroft
qmc_reference.qmc_parameters: L=8, U/t=4, T/t=0.1, density approximately 0.875, t'=0; uniform site disorder
qmc_reference.reported_trend: QMC stiffness falls strongly with disorder and is zero at W/t=4; the paper estimates a critical disorder near 3–4t.

comparison_limits: This run compares the disorder trend, not pointwise numerical values.
The project estimates fixed-density mean-field free-energy curvature; QMC obtains stiffness from current-current correlations.
QMC targets density after disorder averaging; this run enforces target density separately for each realization.
Eight samples and one phase initialization are a small benchmark check, not a statistical reproduction of QMC.
